  • Method Details

    • getInput

      public boolean getInput()
      This method will be responsible to show the UI to user. This method will also collect the year selected by the player and pass it to the controller. Upon successful execution, the financial results will be shown to the player. If errors occur during the input process, appropriate error messages are displayed to guide the user.
